title: Band Measurement Face with Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance Coverage — Term Life Insurance Accidental Death Rider Expiry
content:
**Term Life Insurance.** For the installment after the accidental death rider ends, the band measurement face is chosen by the owner's Ashgrove permanent coverage on the same insured — the insured's in-force Whole Life Insurance and Universal Life Insurance policies:

- **both** an in-force Ashgrove whole life policy and an in-force Ashgrove universal life policy on record for the insured: the term face amount on record plus both permanent face amounts;
- **exactly one** of the two in force for the insured: the term face amount on record plus that permanent face amount;
- **otherwise**: the term face amount on record alone.

| Hypothetical record | Band measurement face |
|---|---|
| Term face 700000; whole life 200000 in force; universal life 150000 in force | 1050000 |
| Term face 700000; whole life 200000 in force; no universal life | 900000 |
| Term face 700000; whole life lapsed; no universal life | 700000 |
